address: 95-97 Customs Street West, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: In an area not exactly devoid of dining options, Hello Beasty stands out with its Asian-themed menu and vibrant atmosphere. The influences come from Japan, Korea and China so there’s something for everyone and everything is for sharing. Start with potstickers or the delicious brisket bao; pork belly with the crispiest skin is a must, while the prawn and crab toast comes with eye fillet and will satisfy any appetite. However busy it gets, the service team remain impressively unfazed and always make time to offer recommendations.
